slots.label: font-face-label text-ctl-xs tracking-label-role case-label text-ink-muted/(--level-ink-muted)
slots.field: flex items-center gap-control min-h-ctl-h px-control-x bg-field border-[length:var(--bw-field)] rounded-field transition-[border-color,box-shadow] duration-[var(--dur-hover)] ease-hover
slots.chips: flex flex-1 flex-wrap items-center gap-inline py-1 min-w-0
slots.more: inline-flex items-center rounded-marker border-[length:var(--bw-marker)] border-edge-marker px-marker-x py-marker-y text-ctl-xs font-semibold text-ink-muted/(--level-ink-muted)
slots.input: flex-1 min-w-0 bg-transparent border-none outline-none text-ink-body placeholder:text-ink-muted/(--level-ink-muted) font-body text-ctl
slots.clear: inline-flex items-center justify-center min-h-ctl-h-sm min-w-ctl-h-sm bg-transparent border-none cursor-pointer text-ink-muted/(--level-ink-muted) text-[length:var(--icon-sm)]
slots.panel: grow z-dropdown max-h-80 overflow-auto p-1.5 bg-surface-floating border-[length:var(--bw-surface)] border-edge-surface-floating rounded-surface-floating shadow-surface-floating
slots.option: flex items-center gap-row-floating w-full min-h-row-min text-left px-row-floating-x py-row-floating-y rounded-control font-body text-md

floating.panel: a list panel floats over the page, so the form holding its field does not decide its rows

internal.state: error when error is given, valid when valid holds
internal.active: the row the keyboard cursor is on
internal.selected: the row whose value is chosen
internal.blocked: a row that cannot be chosen because the cap is reached
